The [[Rainbow Phoenix]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in the [[Hall of Monuments]]. Although this pet starts with an average size, it grows to be the largest pet in the game.

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Hall of Monuments}} (see notes)

== Acquisition ==
[[File:rainbow phoenix fullgrown.jpg|thumb|189px|right|Size comparison between a level 20 Rainbow Phoenix and a character.]]
* [[Hall of Monuments]], if the [[character]] has met the following conditions:
*# Enters the Hall alone (''no heroes, henchmen, or other players'').
*# Has added four [[Monumental Tapestry|Monumental Tapestries]].
*# Has completed [[A Time for Heroes]].
*# Has maxed titles:
*#* Has earned [[Kind of a Big Deal|"Kind of a Big Deal"]] (5 titles) and has also filled most of the five monuments. <small>(exact requirement unknown - see the [[Talk:Rainbow Phoenix|discussion page]] for details.)</small>
*#* Has earned [[Kind of a Big Deal|"People Know Me"]] (10 titles), without any additional prerequisites.
* [[Zaishen Menagerie]], the ''Tyrian Prestige'' pet can be [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|unlocked]] by: 
** Having another character (on the same account) release the animal to [[Emryd the Tamer]] ''or''
** Giving [[Helena]] (Zaishen Keeper):
*** 15{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} ''or''
*** 80,000 [[Balthazar Faction]].

== Notes ==
* Because it only appears when you are alone ''and'' when there are no resurrection shrines, even in the Zaishen Menagerie:
** This is the only pet that cannot be charmed by [[hero]]es.
** It is the only pet that cannot be [[Death leveling|death leveled]] ''easily'' (it takes well over four hours to [[spam]] over 500 uses of [[Eternal Aura]], the only self-resurrection skill that prevents [[wipe]]s). <!-- please read the relevant talk page before changing this -->
* Hearty, Playful, Elder, and Aggressive Rainbow Phoenixes deal [[piercing damage]], while Dire and Unevolved Rainbow Phoenixes deal [[slashing damage]].
* The unlocking costs require obtaining 7,500 {{zcopper}} + {{cost|2350}} ''or'' the equivalent of earning 14 ranks total in the [[Gladiator]], [[Hero (Title)|Hero]], [[Champion]], [[Codex Title|Codex]], or [[Commander]] title tracks.

{{Anomaly|The Phoenix can appear in your Hall of Monuments under other conditions than listed above. However, no one has yet advanced a successful theory that explains the exceptions. Some players speculate that things have changed since the introduction of the account-wide view of the HoM. See the [[Talk:Rainbow Phoenix|discussion page]] for details.}}

== Trivia ==
* Before the existence of the Zaishen Menagerie, it was impossible to obtain this pet without meeting the Hall of Monument requirements.
* During their idle animation, they will shake their head to look right and left.
* Their wings make a flapping sound as they move.
* It was impossible to [[death level]] the Rainbow Phoenix prior to the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110217|February 17, 2011 update]] that turned [[Eternal Aura]] into the only [[resurrection]] skill that prevents a party [[wipe]].
